Interact always targets the facing tile (2,6), which is empty. The notice board at (2,7) is never the interact target because it's my own tile.

This is a genuine soft-lock: I spawned on the notice board tile and can't move off it. 

Let me reconsider whether the notice board is really at (2,7). The observe lists "Notice Board (notice) at (2,7): blocks". But maybe the coordinate is the board's anchor and it actually occupies a different tile. Let me try facing down and interacting — the board might be at (2,8)? No, that's empty.

Let me try one more thing: maybe movement works if I hold two directions or if there's a diagonal. Or maybe the game needs a fresh input after some time. Let me wait a bit and retry.
